sources.title: Büro mieten im Stücki Park – Arbeitsräume, die mit dir wachsen
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The same HO60A, HO60B, HO60C, BA03 and HO70 inventory appears under Verfügbare Mietflächen. Einzelne Teambüros: Office 1 | 109 m² | vermietet; Office 2 | 59 m² | vermietet; Office 3 | 59 m² | vermietet; Office 4 | 108 m² | vermietet; Office 5 | 109 m² | vermietet; Office 6 | 59 m² | auf Anfrage | PDF | mieten; Office 7 | 108 m² | vermietet. Die Büro­räume im Level 1 und 2 zwischen 59m² und 135m². Grossraumbüros: Level 3–7, zwischen 200m² und 810m²; nach Ihren Bedürfnissen ausgebaut oder im Grundausbau vermietet. Vollausgebautes Büro: Büroflächen von 196 m2 bis 266 m2. These ranges do not specify a non-overlapping available-area total.

sources.title: Business Park – Hier treiben Unternehmen Innovationen voran
sources.evidenceExcerpt: Im Business Park arbeiten etablierte Marktführer und visionäre Start-ups Tür an Tür. Zu den Mieter:innen gehören unter anderem [tenant links including Lonza, Medartis, NBE Therapeutics, Superlab Suisse and Tech Park Basel]. Der Stücki Park bietet skalierbare Offices (59–810 m²), voll ausgestattete Labore sowie Retail- und Gastroflächen in der Mall.

sources.title: Stücki Park – where life sciences and business come together
sources.evidenceExcerpt: Swiss Prime Site made the decision to significantly expand the site in two construction phases (four new buildings) and double the area from 27 000 m² to 60 000 m². The first two new buildings – each with a surface area of 8 000 m² – were completed at the end of 2020. One of the buildings has already been occupied by the new tenant Lonza. In another building, flexible office and meeting rooms were created that can be booked at short notice by site tenants and other users. Two additional, identical buildings are still under construction and are due to be completed in 2024.

sources.title: Stücki Park II – A piece more laboratory!
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The four finger docks of the Stücki Park II project comprise three buildings with laboratory and research spaces as well as a building with office floor space that can be leased out both for long and short terms of contract. The four new buildings are connected by a shared three-storey base structure below ground level. Facts & Figures: Utilisation: Laboratory and offices; Usable floor space: 28 000m²; Completion: End of 2024; Construction phase: 2020–2023 (basic fit-out, then tenant-specific fit-outs). The tenant Superlab Suisse has been providing a new lab-as-a-service in Stücki Park since mid-2024.

sources.title: Superlab Suisse Basel – Base in Basel, Scale worldwide
sources.evidenceExcerpt: Book a Lab; Private Lab, Shared Lab, Facility Pass, Office. Ready-to-move-in facilities: Biology & chemistry labs, equipped, with core facilities. Shared facilities included. Superlab Suisse Basel AG; Stücki Park; Hochbergerstr. 60 I, 4057 Basel. No available square-metre inventory is stated on the retrieved page.

gaps: Research cutoff and retrieval date are 2026-11-04. One discovery search followed by one targeted primary-source resolution pass was completed; no broader property universe was researched.

The live leasing pages do not show a verifiable publication or last-update date. publishedDate is null for these sources. Asset upload paths, footer year, old plan dates and search-result indexing are not treated as webpage recency.

All currently offered units are current_marketed, not specifically owner-confirmed physical vacancy. No unit-specific confirmation of present occupation, committed lease status or exact handover date was obtained. An undated live offer is marketing evidence, not proof that the premises are empty.

The ten individually quantified current office/lab-premises offers sum to 7,607 m² on their advertised bases: 6,307 m² office/office-compatible premises and 1,300 m² lab-labelled premises. The lab-labelled subtotal consists of a 901 m² fitted BSL2 premises total and 399 m² shell premises; it is not a net fitted-lab-area subtotal. Generic office ranges and unquantified Superlab offers are excluded, so the sum is not a complete campus vacancy figure.

HO60B Level 1+2 has a material area conflict: current advertised 399 m² versus linked Wincasa plan measurements totaling 410.71 m². Visible listing identity is 60B while its HTML identifier contains 60A, and the plans label only 60A–E. Neither discrepancy was silently resolved.
HO70 Level 2 is categorized as office in the primary inventory HTML. Laboratory capability, fitted-lab share and laboratory conversion consent are not established for its 3,000 m².

The 901 m² BSL2 offer gives total premises area but no separate laboratory, office, circulation or support-space schedule. None of the mixed-use campus or tenant-premises areas is treated as fitted-lab floor area.
Only HO60A explicitly states Bezug nach Vereinbarung in the live unit text. Other units' availableFrom values remain null rather than inferred as immediate occupancy.

Exact building/street identity is not established for the ZIP Office 6 and generic office-range offers from the cited primary-page text and ZIP factsheet. The 522 m² HO60C office is retained by its exact leasing identity without assuming the imported Tech Park building mapping.

The operator currently identifies Superlab Suisse Basel at Hochbergerstrasse 60 I, but publishes no available square metres or suite schedule. The historical capacity observation is not vacancy and may overlap both the campus and Park II constituent records.

The 60,000 m² campus figure, 28,000 m² Park II figure and 8,000 m² expansion-building figure have different stock scopes and overlap. They are excluded from availability and never summed with one another or with tenant/service footprints.

Tenant directory presence, occupied research centres and historical building completions do not establish owner occupation, current vacancy or campus-wide fully-let status. fully_let is used only for the six individual ZIP offices expressly marked vermietet.
